newsitem.title: USA: Cygnus sees delay in GlucoWatch.
newsitem.headline: Cygnus sees delay in GlucoWatch.

text.p: Cygnus Inc said the latest prototype of its GlucoWatch monitoring device will be delayed because of a change in its application specific integrated circuit (ASIC) component.
It said the ASIC serves as the brains of GlucoWatch by issuing operating instructions for sample collection, measurement and storage of data.

It said it expects to receive the new shipment of prototype GlucoWatches with the modified ASIC by early 1997, but added "actual timing will depend on the supplier's ability to complete the task swiftly."
The prototypes are being targeted for use in advanced development activities.

"The good news is this problem is not difficult to resolve; however, it is a time consuming process which will delay the start of our planned development efforts and clinical testing activities," said Gregory Lawless, Cygnus president and chief executive officer.
